source_book: NCERT Chemistry Class 11 Ch.6 Equilibrium §6.8 (Le Chatelier's principle) + Cambridge IGCSE / IB DP / AP / A-level reversible reactions and equilibrium

real_world_anchor.primary: An industrial reactor that joins two gases together to make ammonia — the Haber process. The reaction settles into a balance long before it has made anything like all the ammonia it could, and the engineers cannot change the chemistry. So they disturb it instead: the gases are squeezed to hundreds of atmospheres, because the product side has fewer molecules and crowding pays that side more — the exact beat STATE_3 puts on screen. The temperature is the harder bargain, and it is the one STATE_4 explains: the reaction gives out heat, so a cooler reactor would settle richer in ammonia, yet a cooler reactor is also a slower one. The plant runs warmer than the balance would like, and buys the rate back with pressure.
real_world_anchor.secondary: An opened bottle of fizzy drink going flat: the gas above the liquid keeps escaping, so the dissolved-gas balance keeps chasing a settle-point it never reaches.
real_world_anchor.why_it_matters: Turns the principle from a rule to memorise into an engineering lever, and into a real trade-off a student can reason about: STATE_3 is why the reactor is pressurised, STATE_4 is why it is not simply run cold, and STATE_5 is why a catalyst helps the speed without ever improving the yield.

V.name: box volume as a fraction of full width

N.name: reagent tap — particles added or removed as free A only (reaction.inject: 'A'). Range 130-260 is the STATE_8 SLIDER; STATE_7 authors N 516 directly as a deliberate density exception, which no slider reaches.

activation_fwd_kT.name: forward barrier, in multiples of kT at ea_ref_T

bond_energy_kT.name: energy released when the bond forms (> 0 = exothermic forward)

reverse_attempt_per_s.name: Arrhenius pre-exponential factor for the decay of a bonded pair

catalyst_activation_fwd_kT.name: forward barrier once STATE_5's catalyst cue fires — the ONE authorised override of a reaction constant in this concept

ea_ref_T.name: reference temperature the barriers are pinned to

m_AB.name: mass of the bonded pair — derived and enforced at init, never authored freely

m_X.name: mass of the inert species (STATE_6 only)

r_AB.name: disc radius of the bonded pair — derived and enforced at init

r_X.name: disc radius of the inert species (STATE_6 only)

n_X.name: live population of the inert species (STATE_6 only)

rate_f.name: forward event rate, sampled over a 5 s window

rate_r.name: reverse event rate, sampled over a 5 s window

K_ratio.name: measured equilibrium ratio [AB] / ([A][B]) shown in STATE_7's K chip, averaged over a rolling 10 s window

formulas.forward_rate: rate of the forward reaction is proportional to n_A x n_B (an A must meet a B)
formulas.reverse_rate: rate of the reverse reaction is proportional to n_AB (a bonded pair breaks on its own)
formulas.equilibrium: at equilibrium the two rates are equal, so the amounts stop changing while both reactions keep running
formulas.le_chatelier: a disturbance makes the two rates briefly unequal; the system re-settles in the direction that partially counteracts the disturbance, and never fully undoes it
formulas.k_ratio: K = [AB] / ([A][B]) as raw box counts — portable across starting compositions at a fixed temperature, not a literal textbook K_c

constraints: atoms of each unit are conserved except across an authored inject_cue, which adds or removes free reagent directly and IS the state's disturbance: A-units (n_A + n_AB) and B-units (n_B + n_AB) are otherwise constant for the whole life of a state
total charge: LHS = RHS = 0 in every displayed equation; there are no ions and no state symbols anywhere in this concept — A/B/AB are abstract model species
m_AB = m_A + m_B and r_AB = sqrt(r_A^2 + r_B^2), forced at init by gasRxResolveSpecies() — mass and disc area are both conserved by a reaction event
Ea_rev = Ea_fwd + E_bond is DERIVED and must never be authored; reverse_attempt_per_s is the only reverse knob

the equilibrium position depends only on bond_energy_kT, reverse_attempt_per_s, temperature and density; activation_fwd_kT changes the speed of both directions only — STATE_5's reaction_at_cue override to 0.5 is the ONE authorised change to a reaction constant in this concept, and the plateau it produces (31.80) sits inside the untouched baseline band, which is what proves the catalyst result is emergent, not scripted

STATE_3 is isothermal (adiabatic: false) so the compression is a pure Boyle beat and does not smuggle STATE_4's temperature variable into a different state (Rule 32b); only STATE_4 changes temperature, via T_from/T, never via adiabatic piston heating

species X (inert, STATE_6 only) is strictly elastic — never converted, never removed. Every state must author X: 0 explicitly in species_counts unless X is meant to be present at entry: gasInit fills an undeclared species with the leftover particle budget, not zero (measured: X silently opened at 31)

K as printed is a raw-count ratio specific to this box's geometry and particle count — portable across starting compositions at fixed temperature (the STATE_7 claim), never a literal textbook Kc. Measured 10 s window swing is 50%, so STATE_7 never narrates it as 'this number stays fixed'. Its claim is a BEFORE/AFTER observable inside the state: K reads ≈0.0094 before the +80 A cue at 9 s and ≈0.0094 after, while A settles a mean +52% above its opening (8 seeds)

reaction constants activation_fwd_kT 1.2, bond_energy_kT 2.1, reverse_attempt_per_s 8, ea_ref_T 300, speed_scale 0.105, count 180 are NOT retuned anywhere in this concept except STATE_5's authorised reaction_at_cue override; check:gas-reaction and the shipped dynamic_equilibrium both depend on them staying fixed

aha_moment.statement: Heating an exothermic mixture unmakes product, not by will but by arithmetic.
aha_moment.visual_confirmation: the joined-pair curve slides down while every rate number climbs — collision statistics, not a scripted shift

scene_composition.role: the sealed container — the apparatus that persists unchanged in every state (Rule 32d home pose)
the settled mixture: fifty-nine A, fifty-nine B, thirty-one joined pairs, in constant random motion
green rings surging as the extra A finds partners, right after the cue
the forward bar leaping past the reverse bar, then both re-meeting higher than they started — the focal (Rule 32e)
A jumping to eighty-nine at the cue, then easing back as some of it is used up
the joined-pair curve stepping up to a new, higher flat line
A + B ⇌ AB

misconception_watch.belief: Shifting right means the reverse reaction stops.
misconception_watch.visual_counter: the reverse bar never reads zero during the shift, and re-meets the forward bar at a higher rate than before
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: The shift is a temporary imbalance between two running rates, not a shutdown of one.

tts_sentences.text_en: This box sits at equilibrium, pairs forming exactly as fast as pairs break apart.
Now thirty more A pour in.
Forward rate leaps past reverse, and the joined-pair count climbs from about thirty to about thirty-eight.
Both rates settle level again, higher than before: the reverse never stopped, only outrun.

scene_composition.role: the same box, the same home pose (Rule 32d) — only the disturbance's sign has flipped from STATE_1
the settled mixture opening identically to STATE_1, before the cue fires
orange rings firing as joined pairs break apart to replace the missing A
reverse leading briefly, then the two bars re-meeting lower than they started
A crashing toward twenty-six at the cue, then climbing back to about thirty-eight — visibly short of fifty-nine, the focal (Rule 32e)
the joined-pair curve falling to a new, lower flat line
A + B ⇌ AB

misconception_watch.belief: The system undoes the disturbance completely.
misconception_watch.visual_counter: A's curve flattens visibly short of its old level; the narration reads the settled number against the original one
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: The system pushes back part-way — it never gets all the way home.

tts_sentences.text_en: This box sits at equilibrium, the same balance as before.
Now thirty A are pulled back out.
A crashes low, then some joined pairs break apart to replace it, and the count climbs to about thirty-eight.
That settled level sits short of the original fifty-nine: the system replaces only part of what was taken.

scene_composition.role: the sealed container, opening at full width — the same apparatus as every other state
the movable wall — the piston IS the cause object, sliding from full width to just over half before anything else changes (Rule 32a) — the focal (Rule 32e)
the settled mixture, crowding together as the wall slides in
the pressure bar climbing as the box shrinks
both rates climbing as the crowd thickens, forward climbing more
the joined-pair curve stepping up to a new, higher flat line
A + B ⇌ AB

tts_sentences.text_en: This box sits at equilibrium, the piston open all the way.
Now watch the wall slide in, squeezing the gas to just over half its width.
As the crowd thickens, the pair count dips, then climbs above where it started.
It settles near forty-three, up from thirty-one — squeezing favors the two particles becoming one.

scene_composition.role: the same box, the same settled opening as every other state
the settled mixture, discs blurring faster as the bath heats
the thermometer climbing from three hundred toward five hundred kelvin — the cause, moving first (Rule 32a)
both bars climbing, the reverse bar overtaking the forward bar while the temperature is still rising
the joined-pair curve sliding down to about twenty-two, even though every rate got faster — the focal, the aha (Rule 32e)
A + B ⇌ AB + heat — heat earns its place on the equation here, and persists from now on

misconception_watch.belief: Heating always makes more product, the way adding reactant or squeezing the box did.
misconception_watch.visual_counter: the joined-pair curve slides down while every rate number climbs higher than before
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: Heating helps the harder reaction more — here that is breaking the bond apart, not making it.

tts_sentences.text_en: This box sits at equilibrium.
Now the thermostat heats it from three hundred toward five hundred kelvin.
While the temperature is still climbing, the reverse rate overtakes the forward rate.
Every rate ends up faster than before, yet the joined-pair count settles lower, near twenty-two: hotter hits favour breaking the bond apart.

scene_composition.role: the same box, the same settled opening as every other state
the settled mixture, discs firing green and orange rings faster from the moment the cue lands
both bars roughly doubling in length together, right after the cue — the focal (Rule 32e)
A fifty-nine, B fifty-nine, AB thirty-one — unmoved by the faster traffic
a flat line straight through the cue, no shift at all
A + B ⇌ AB + heat

misconception_watch.belief: A catalyst shifts equilibrium toward more product.
misconception_watch.visual_counter: both rate values run about twice as fast while the counts keep wandering in the same band they always have, with no sustained rise
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: A catalyst lowers both barriers equally: faster arrival, same destination.

tts_sentences.text_en: This box sits at equilibrium, thirty-one joined pairs, fifty-nine free A and B.
Now a catalyst lowers both barriers together.
Both rates roughly double, forward and reverse together.
The counts keep wandering in the same band as before — no lasting shift toward more product.

STATE_6.title: Add a gas that never reacts

scene_composition.role: the same box, the same settled opening — the volume itself never changes in this state
the settled mixture, joined at the cue by forty grey discs that only ever bounce elastically

the pressure gauge climbing clearly above where it opened, right after the cue — direction only, never a percentage: the fractional jump measures anywhere from 15.4% to 48.4% run to run at a FIXED viewport
forward and reverse holding exactly where they were, unmoved by the crowding
A fifty-nine, B fifty-nine, AB thirty-one, unmoved — the focal (Rule 32e)
a flat line straight through the cue, no shift at all
A + B ⇌ AB + heat

tts_sentences.text_en: This box sits at equilibrium, the volume unchanged.
Now forty grey particles pour in, a gas that never reacts.
The pressure gauge climbs above where it opened.
More gas in the box, higher pressure — and the balance does not move at all.

scene_composition.role: a denser box than the rest of the lesson — deliberately, so the ratio chip has enough pairs to be readable; still the same apparatus, opened at its own settled pose
the settled mixture, a hundred and fifty-six A against a hundred and fifty-six B — until eighty more A pour in partway through
A jumping from a hundred and fifty-six at the cue, then easing back as the box responds
forward and reverse converging as the drift proceeds
three curves easing back toward their familiar flat lines
the K value the box measures, converging near the same number it reads unperturbed — the focal (Rule 32e)
Kc = [AB] / ([A][B]) — the ratio vocabulary is quarantined to this one state (Rule 38a)

misconception_watch.belief: Adding more reactant changes the equilibrium constant.
misconception_watch.visual_counter: the count of A jumps far above where it opened and settles high, yet the ratio chip keeps landing back within a few percent of its starting number
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: Amounts move; the ratio doesn't. Only temperature changes that number.

tts_sentences.text_en: The same box, packed far fuller: completely different amounts.
It settles at equilibrium, a ratio chip tracking A, B and the pairs.
Now eighty more A pour in, just like before.
A jumps and settles higher, yet the ratio lands back near where it opened.
Different amounts, almost the same ratio: only temperature moves it.

scene_composition.role: the live sandbox, opening from the config default and running continuously (Rule 37)
the reaction running live through every drag
the bars re-levelling after each disturbance — the instrument that carries this state's only claim
the line re-flattening at a new level after each push
temperature, volume, and the reagent tap — all three live at once (Rule 31 explore-last)
A + B ⇌ AB + heat — core-ring content only; no ratio chip here (Rule 38b)

tts_sentences.text_en: Your turn. Heat it, cool it, squeeze the box, add or remove some A.
Whatever you disturb, the two rates come back together and the line goes flat again.
That is Le Chatelier's principle: disturb a settled equilibrium and it shifts to oppose you — settling somewhere new, never back where it started.

regeneration_variants.label: Same physics, a different world (an opened fizzy drink losing its fizz)
regeneration_variants.physical_world: An opened bottle of fizzy drink left standing: carbon dioxide keeps escaping into the air above the liquid, so the dissolved-gas balance keeps chasing a settle-point it can never fully reach — the same partial, temporary-imbalance story as pulling reactant out of the reactor, just for a physical rather than a chemical equilibrium.

authoring_notes.measured_constants: Reaction constants reused verbatim from the shipped dynamic_equilibrium (activation_fwd_kT 1.2, bond_energy_kT 2.1, reverse_attempt_per_s 8, ea_ref_T 300, speed_scale 0.105, count 180) — NOT retuned. The isothermal 300 K plateau from {A:59,B:59,AB:31} is measured: AB mean 29.68, fwd 10.21/s, rev 10.27/s (0.6% long-window mismatch), K = 0.00857. Every disturbed-state number in this file was measured on the emitted particle_field_renderer.ts via a headless vm harness — never computed, never guessed. Permanent gate: npm run check:gas-reaction. Values below are POST-FIX-PASS (2026-07-29), re-measured after the thermometer-collision and piston-ramp engine fixes (commit 458a6e3): S1 AB→37.58, rates re-meet higher than before; S2 A→~38.9 (9 runs, range 34.7–42.9), AB→20.6; S3 with piston_ramp_ms 6000 — peak measured T 322–337 K (vs 7173–9594 K on the default unramped stroke), forward leads on net through the response window (mean fwd−rev +0.75/s, positive in all 10 seeds), settled AB 43.1 (35.9–48.5); S4 AB→22.28, reverse overtakes forward at t≈1.7 s INSIDE the T_from ramp; S5 rates ×2.11/×2.12, AB band 31.1–36.0 vs baseline band 29.7–31.9 (a +8% gap that sits inside check:gas-reaction's own no-shift tolerance — narrate the BAND, never a point value: single frames legitimately read 26–38); S6 pressure direction-only (fractional jump ranges 15.4%–48.4% run to run at a FIXED viewport, so no percentage is honest), AB 30.45, X held at exactly 40; S7 (redesigned to open at the home pose and inject +30 A at 9 s) K ≈0.0094 before the cue and ≈0.0094 after, while A settles +27% to +52% above its opening (mean +41%). CAVEAT: every rate and pressure figure here is as-measured-at-900×560 — gasRxAreaNorm normalises the equilibrium COMPOSITION, not the displayed readouts, which span ~3.9× (rates) and ~4× (pressure) from 900×560 to 1600×900. Composition counts are viewport-stable and are the only magnitudes safe to narrate.
authoring_notes.x_species_authoring_trap: gasInit fills any species OMITTED from a state's species_counts with the leftover particle budget, not zero — measured: X silently opened at 31 when omitted. Every one of this concept's eight states therefore authors X: 0 explicitly except STATE_6, where the inert-gas cue pours X in from that same zero.
authoring_notes.k_ratio_comparative_claim: STATE_7's K chip is noisy because K's relative fluctuation scales as 1/sqrt(n_AB). At the lesson's normal density n_AB is ~30 and the chip swung 33%, so the RATIO moved more than the amounts and the state's contrast ran backwards. Two averaging windows (5 s, then 10 s) were measured failing — the noise is physics, not the instrument. Fixed by density, not by averaging: STATE_7 runs n_AB ~204, and the measured before/after is |dK| 8-10% against |dA| 34-42%, 0 of 8 seeds inverting, at 900x560, 1280x720 and 1600x900. Read off the shipped frames: K 0.0089 pre-cue, 0.0094 at the end (+5.6%) while A goes 138 to 210 (+52%) — the amounts outrun the ratio about 9 to 1.
authoring_notes.catalyst_authorised_override: STATE_5's reaction_at_cue sets activation_fwd_kT to 0.5 on the add_catalyst cue — the ONE authorised change to a reaction constant anywhere in this concept. Ea_rev falls by exactly the same amount (the bond energy is added on top of whatever Ea_fwd is), so the 'no shift' result is emergent from the derivation, not scripted: measured plateau 31.80 sits inside the untouched baseline's fluctuation band.
authoring_notes.isothermal_S3_vs_S4: STATE_3 (the squeeze) is authored adiabatic:false so compression stays a pure Boyle beat and never smuggles STATE_4's temperature variable into a different state (Rule 32b) — even though piston work transiently bumps the measured gas temperature before the thermostat pulls it back, that detail is deliberately NOT narrated in STATE_3; temperature is STATE_4's variable alone.
authoring_notes.vocabulary_quarantine: K, Kc, [A], [AB] and 'equilibrium constant'/'ratio' vocabulary are quarantined to STATE_7 (Rule 38a cut check: hiding STATE_7 leaves STATE_1–STATE_6 + STATE_8 coherent with zero undefined terms). Hiding STATE_6 + STATE_7 leaves STATE_1–STATE_5 + STATE_8 coherent — inert gas and species X appear nowhere else. STATE_8 (explore) surfaces core-ring content only: A + B ⇌ AB + heat, no ratio chip (Rule 38b).
authoring_notes.engine_fixed_vocabulary: fwd / rev, N.N/s, 'K = N.NNNN', 'count' / 'time →', and the counts chip are drawn by the renderer and cannot be authored — narration uses those exact words. The bonded product is drawn as the blue A disc and pink B disc joined by a white bond, so it is narrated as 'a joined pair', never as a violet disc.
authoring_notes.duration_and_continuous_motion: Every state is continuously in motion by construction (gas_box particles never stop), which is why the Rule 31a gate measures these states against their authored duration. NOTE, measured: at the player's own pacing (estSentenceMs, rate 0.9) narration overruns the authored `duration` on S1, S2, S3, S4 and S5 — S3 is the widest, 25.9 s of narration against a 20 s duration. Harmless at runtime, because computeTimeline derives the timeline from the sentences and not from `duration`; the consequence is only that eye_capture_ms stops before the narration does on those states. Nothing new happens in the tail (S3's piston finishes at 6 s).
authoring_notes.s1_s7_declared_contrast_pair: STATE_1 and STATE_7 perform the same physical action (inject A) and are DECLARED a Rule 31 contrast pair: S1 shows the amounts moving, S7 shows the ratio NOT moving under the same disturbance. They are visually distinct as well as conceptually — S1 is the sparse box, +30 A, focal on the rate bars; S7 is the dense box, +80 A, focal on the K chip.
authoring_notes.s7_particle_density_is_deliberate: STATE_7 runs ~516 particles where every other state runs ~150 — a deliberate, measured exception to Rule 32d home-pose continuity, taken on founder decision after the state failed two audit cycles. K's relative fluctuation scales as 1/sqrt(n_AB), and at the lesson's normal density n_AB is only ~30, so the chip swung 33% and in 10/10 seeds the RATIO moved more than the amounts did — the state's whole contrast ran backwards on screen. Two averaging windows (5 s, then 10 s) were tried and measured failing; the noise is set by physics, not by the instrument. At this density n_AB is ~204 and the measured before/after gap is |dK| 8-10% against |dA| 34-42%, with ZERO of 8 seeds inverting, holding at 900x560, 1280x720 and 1600x900. Cost: 2.18 ms/tick against a 16.7 ms budget (the collision sweep is spatially gridded, so it scales linearly). The denser box is visible and is called out in the state's own scene roles rather than hidden.
authoring_notes.t_floor_200_measured: The T slider floor is 200 K, not 250, by measurement: cooling from the 300 K plateau moves AB 31->~35 at 250 K (invisible, inside the fluctuation band) but 31->~45 within 10 s at 200 K with fwd still 3.5/s (box visibly alive). At 150 K fwd falls to 1.1/s and the box reads near-dead. The mirror of the PRIMARY aha — cooling an exothermic mixture MAKES product — is only demonstrable with this floor, and it is the single most likely what-if a student asks after STATE_4.
